ns2:course.label: Small Business Consulting
ns2:course.description: Through guided experience, students identify and offer advice to local small business firms; exposes students, serving as consultants, to the wide variety of problems facing the smaller firm as well as enables them to apply current business methods to real problems. Students work in teams. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing. Restricted to BS:Accountancy -UIUC, BS:Finance -UIUC, BS: Marketing - UIUC, BS: Inf Sys & Info Tech -UIUC, BS: Supply Chain Mgmt -UIUC, BS: Business Process Mgt -UIUC, BS: Management -UIUC, BS:Information Systems -UIUC, BS:Operations Management -UIUC, BS:STR BUS DEV & ENT - UIUC, BS: Business Multi Majors-UIUC, BS:General Engineering -UIUC, BS:Industrial Engineerng -UIUC, BS:Systems Engr & Design -UIUC, MS:Business Administrtn -UIUC, MBA: (PT) Business Adm -- UIUC, MS: Technology Management-UIUC, MS: Finance Cost Rec - UIUC, MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC, or MS:Management -UIUC.
